description: This source file contains the implementation of the Smarty_Internal_Runtime_TplFunction class, which manages runtime template functions, including calling, registering, and caching template functions within the Smarty templating system.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Runtime_TplFunction
classes.description: Handles runtime management of template functions for Smarty, including calling functions, registration, source retrieval, and cache integration.

methods.name: callTemplateFunction
methods.description: Calls a previously registered template function with provided parameters, handling cache considerations and dynamic loading.

methods.name: registerTplFunctions
methods.description: Registers one or multiple template functions to a Smarty template object, with an option to override existing functions, and propagates registration to parent templates if applicable.

methods.name: getTplFunction
methods.description: Retrieves source parameter array(s) for a specific template function or all functions associated with the template.

methods.name: addTplFuncToCache
methods.description: Attempts to add a template function's source code to cache files for nocache calls by extracting function code from compiled files and evaluating it.

methods.name: saveTemplateVariables
methods.description: Saves the current template variables and configurations onto a stack for temporary modification.

methods.name: restoreTemplateVariables
methods.description: Restores previously saved template variables from the stack to maintain state after function execution.
